findings.summary: Carrying the 'Met this goal' choice over from the previous log means a goal already met (or a different, earlier goal) can be pre-checked, so new logs may falsely record the current goal as met; the old 'defaults unchecked' safeguard was removed.
findings.evidence:
- Met this goal defaults unchecked and is disabled when no current goal exists
+ channel, depth and the Met this goal choice carry over, the date defaults to now and the note starts empty.

findings.summary: The prefill rule does not say what the form shows when the person has no previous log, so channel, depth and Met this goal have no initial value for a first log.
findings.evidence: + The form opens prefilled from this person's previous log ... / + description: Prefilled with the channel of this person's previous log

findings.summary: ChannelSelect and DepthSelect gained prefill descriptions but MetGoalCheckbox did not, even though the screen description says its choice also carries over, so the component-level spec is inconsistent.
findings.evidence:
+ description: Prefilled with the depth of this person's previous log
  - id: component.MetGoalCheckbox ... name: MetGoalCheckbox (no description added)
